_readme: Provenance only. numbers are the digits painted on the log ends in that photo. One card may list several numbers when they share a photo. stock_link stays empty until a real match is confirmed — do not point a log at a stock slab. No prices, dimensions, or moisture. Species is plop negru bubos / black poplar. The standing tree is the hero, not a card. The held mappa slab (09) does not belong here.
